entries.name: img402 Image Upload
entries.description: Upload an image and get a public CDN URL in a single x402-paid call. Send a base64-encoded image (max 5MB) to POST /api/upload; pay $0.01 USDC on Base via x402 and the response contains the hosted CDN URL with 1-year retention. No accounts or API keys. For permanent retention, pre-mint a token via /api/upload/token/permanent ($1) and pass it as X-Upload-Token.

usage.callShape: POST https://img402.dev/api/upload with JSON body {"file":"<base64 image bytes>"}. x402-paid $0.01 USDC on Base. NO token header needed — paying x402 directly is sufficient. Optionally pass header X-Upload-Token (from /api/upload/token or .../permanent) instead of paying, to skip x402.
usage.outputShape: url (public CDN url, e.g. https://i.img402.dev/<id>.png), id (10-char nanoid), contentType (image/png|jpeg|gif|webp), sizeBytes (int), expiresAt (ISO 8601, or null for permanent), img402 (informational news/thanks/feedback block — ignore)
quirks: field is 'file' and must be BASE64-encoded image bytes (not a URL, not multipart) — max 5MB decoded.

The old registry docs' two-step token flow is UNNECESSARY for the standard tier: /api/upload accepts a direct x402 payment and returns the CDN URL immediately. The token endpoints are optional pre-payment only.
/api/upload/token (the other registry backend) is NOT this operation: it mints a single-use token (valid ~10 min) and returns {token,expiresAt} with NO CDN URL. Do not point upload users at it.
expiresAt is non-null (~1 year out) for the $0.01 tier; only the $1 permanent tier (X-Upload-Token from /api/upload/token/permanent) yields expiresAt:null.
Response carries an 'img402' metadata block (news/thanks/feedback) that is informational only.
Free tier exists at POST /api/free (1MB, 7-day retention, no payment) — same {file:<base64>} input shape.

entries.name: Stableflare Image Upload
entries.description: Upload an image by URL to Cloudflare Images and get back an image id plus public delivery URLs in a single x402-paid call. Pay $0.01 USDC on Base via x402 — no accounts or API keys. Use the returned id with the /api/images/transform endpoint to generate resized/reformatted variant URLs.

url.description: Public URL of the image to upload.

requireSignedURLs.description: Restrict access to signed URLs only.

metadata.description: Custom string key-value metadata for the image.

usage.callShape: SYNC: POST https://stableflare.dev/api/images/upload with JSON body {url, requireSignedURLs?, metadata?} where url is a PUBLIC URL of an image -> 200 {id, filename, uploaded, variants[], meta?}. Result is inline; no polling. Pay per call over x402 ($0.01 USDC on Base), no API key.
usage.outputShape: JSON: id (Cloudflare Images image id, use with /api/images/transform), filename, uploaded (ISO timestamp), variants[] (array of public delivery URLs, e.g. https://imagedelivery.net/<account>/<id>/public), meta (optional custom metadata).
quirks: Uploads by URL, NOT by raw file/multipart — you supply a PUBLIC image URL in the JSON body; there is no binary upload path here.
Synchronous: the delivery URL comes back inline in the 200; no job id, no polling.

The returned id feeds the companion /api/images/transform ($0.01) to generate resized/reformatted variant delivery URLs (width/height/fit/quality/format/etc.) — optional, not required to use the uploaded image.
openapi.json advertises both x402 and MPP (Tempo) payment; only the x402 accept is indexed here (MPP excluded per registry policy).
Set requireSignedURLs:true to restrict delivery to signed URLs; attach arbitrary string metadata via the metadata object.
needs: A public URL pointing to the image to upload.
usage.guide: Upload an image to Cloudflare Images by URL in one x402-paid call. POST JSON {"url":"<public image url>"} (optionally requireSignedURLs, metadata) to https://stableflare.dev/api/images/upload; payment is x402 (~$0.01 USDC on Base, no API key). The 200 response returns {id, filename, uploaded, variants[]} where variants[] are public delivery URLs (imagedelivery.net) and id can be passed to /api/images/transform to generate resized/reformatted variants. Verified by uploading https://i.img402.dev/zx8qjbsfu0.png, which charged $0.01 (tx 0x8061bf7891b78d8dd21569d8d7128e2030686e2116ccc9c35c7d4ec7766a2a65) and returned id 31ef9a5d-adaf-4cc5-766d-c51138ab3000 with a working delivery URL.
